reported.title: Pressure conversion omits 500 mV zero offset
reported.description: millivoltsToKpa() at line 25 divides the raw millivolt reading by MV_PER_KPA without subtracting the 500 mV zero offset, so every reading is inflated by 50 kPa. The measured evidence shows printed 103.6 kPa while the injected input was 50.72 to 54.38 kPa, off by 49.2 kPa, and 11 of 11 values were wrong. The conversion should be (mv - 500) / 10 per the spec. Firmware printed 103.6 kPa at 1.01 s while the injected input was 50.72 to 54.38 kPa: off by 49.2 kPa (tolerance ±2). 11 of 11 values were wrong.

reported.title: Gauge lamp driven from offset-inflated pressure
reported.description: updateGauge() at line 42 compares the un-offset lastKpa against WARN_KPA, so the lamp lights roughly 50 kPa too early and stays lit when true pressure is well below 90 kPa. The measured evidence shows D12 was not LOW for 660 ms while required at 1.33 s, and was not HIGH for 501 ms at 500 ms during full-scale saturation. Correcting the offset in millivoltsToKpa() (line 25) would restore the correct threshold behaviour. D12 was in the wrong state for 3480 ms across 6 interval(s), first at 1.33 s: D12 was not LOW for 660 ms while required (grace 500 ms).

judge_input.spec:
- Pressure transducer on A2 scaled at 10 mV/kPa with a 500 mV zero offset; high-pressure gauge lamp on D12.
- Physical pressure in kPa equals (millivolts − 500) / 10 using a 5.000 V / 1023 ADC span.
- Emit `kPa: <value>` once every 1000 ms with one decimal place.
- Printed pressure must match the injected value within ±2.0 kPa.
- Drive D12 HIGH when pressure is at or above 90.0 kPa; otherwise LOW.
- Continue logging at the same rate while the gauge lamp is lit.
